title: UniformDirectImageBoundCore
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be quasi-compact and quasi-separated with $S$ quasi-compact [def-pc-scheme]. There exists an integer $N>0$ such that for every $E\in D_{QCoh}(O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category] with $H^m(E)=0$ for $m>0$, one has $H^m(Rf_*E)=0$ for $m\ge N$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image].

proof.text: Choose a positive natural bound N for ordinary quasi-coherent module sections on every inverse image of an affine open, using [lem-pc-uniform-inverse-affine-sections-bound]. View N as an integer.

Fix E with no positive homology and m≥N. For an affine U, let F=Γ(f^{-1}U,-) on module sheaves of X. Sectionwise products show F preserves countable products (Lean unfolds openModuleSections and infers preservation of limits). Apply [lem-pc-unbounded-derived-functor-cohomological-bound] with b=0, E.property, and the module bound from Step 1. Integer arithmetic gives 0+N-1<m, so H^m(RF(E))=0.
Apply [lem-pc-direct-image-homology-affine-detection] to these vanishings on every affine U. This gives H^m(Rf_*E)=0, uniformly for every E and m≥N. The original signature is unchanged.

theorem uniform_bound_core
    {X S : Scheme.{u}}
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wX} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wS} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace))]
    (f : X ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f] [CompactSpace S] :
    ∃ N : ℤ, 0 < N ∧
      ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X,
        (∀ m : ℤ, 0 < m → IsZero
          ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) m).obj E.obj)) →
        ∀ m : ℤ, N ≤ m → IsZero ((schemeHigherDirectImage f m).obj E.obj)
